Man City Leaks Whistleblower Rui Pinto Faces Abandonment Amid Threats

Rui Pinto, the whistleblower responsible for leaking documents related to Manchester City, is reportedly facing the withdrawal of witness protection by Portuguese authorities. Pinto, who provided information that led to investigations into alleged financial irregularities by the club, has allegedly received death threats. The Portuguese authorities' decision to withdraw protection comes amid concerns for his safety.
